| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 15 | 1 to 100 | How many update steps run. |
| **Edge threshold K** `kappa` | 20 | 1 to 100 | The difference, in 8-bit levels, at which the conduction falls off. |
| **Step size** `lambda` | 0.2 | 0.01 to 0.25 | How far each step moves a value toward its neighbors. At most 0.25 keeps the scheme stable. |
| **Conduction** `conduction` | Exponential, exp(-(d/K)^2) | Exponential, exp(-(d/K)^2), Rational, 1 / (1 + (d/K)^2) | The function g that turns a difference d into a conduction. Both come from Perona and Malik. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
